# Vocabulary: platform

Platform families a game shipped on at any point.

| id | label | definition |
|---|---|---|
| `pc` | PC | Windows, macOS, Linux, or DOS desktop computers. |
| `console` | Console | Home consoles (PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo home systems, earlier generations). |
| `handheld` | Handheld | Dedicated handheld game devices and hybrids (Game Boy, DS, Switch in handheld use). |
| `mobile` | Mobile | Phones and tablets. |
| `web` | Web | Runs in a browser. |
| `vr` | VR | Head-mounted virtual reality. |
| `dedicated-device` | Dedicated device | Single-purpose hardware such as a keychain pet. |
| `mainframe-early` | Mainframe / early micro | Pre-1985 mainframes, minicomputers, and early home micros. |
